interview.answer: The repair drive’s time and location aren’t specified in the notes.

reflections: Nell wants to help, but she relies on others for concrete details and clear coordination.

events.text: Vik: I’m in for the repair drive, and I’ll pass the word along to a few neighbors. What time are we aiming for?
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’ve just been hearing second-hand, so I’m not sure yet. If you hear a time, please let me know and I’ll help spread it too.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll ask around and share the time as soon as I hear it.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Nell — let’s get the repair drive moving. I can help organize the list and see what needs attention first.
events.speaker: Rosa

events.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’ve been hearing bits and pieces, so a clear list would really help. I can keep an eye out and pass along anything I hear.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn — I’m still hearing things second-hand, so a clear time would help me spread the word. If you hear anything, please let me know.

events.text: Opal: Got it — I’m noting the community center this afternoon and I’ll keep an ear out for any repair drive details.
